overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board properly entered Purpose 3 executive session for a grievance and lawfully withheld the 2013 minutes while the grievance was ongoing.

allegations.summary: Complainant argued she was entitled to the executive session minutes under Purpose 1 (discipline or complaints against an employee), not Purpose 3.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to review whether Ms. Coco would be entitled to the minutes if the executive session had been held under Purpose 1.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly improperly denied a request for minutes of its February 5 and March 14, 2013 executive sessions by withholding them.
allegations.key_passage: The Board therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law by withholding these minutes.
